title: The Typewriter of Vilna
author: Jude Eastwick
blurb: Juniper Hartwell, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must choose which family member gets the last berth before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
